SELECT 'store' t, store_key k, store_id id, store_name nm, city, format, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) vf, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) vt, CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) cd FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR city ILIKE '%Jyv%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'product', product_key, sku, product_name, category, subcategory, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR), CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR), CAST(delisted_on AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_product WHERE sku = 100011

calls.statement: SELECT calendar_date, day_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-10' ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.week_ending_date, s.store_key, s.product_key, s.closing_units, s.closing_value, s.receipts_units, s.adjustment_units, CAST(s.etl_loaded_at AS VARCHAR) loaded
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = s.product_key
WHERE st.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND s.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06'
ORDER BY 1, 8

SELECT max(week_ending_date) mx, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT store_key||'-'||product_key) combos, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale, (SELECT string_agg(fiscal_period_label||' '||CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR), '; ') FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= DATE '2026-08-01') cal FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-20'

SELECT 'sale' t, CAST(f.sale_date AS VARCHAR) d, f.quantity q, f.channel_code c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-14'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return', CAST(r.return_date AS VARCHAR), r.quantity_returned, r.reason_code FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND r.return_date >= DATE '2026-09-14'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), weeks_closed, closure_type||' to '||CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=124
ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement: SELECT s.week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT s.store_key||'-'||s.product_key) combos, sum(CASE WHEN s.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, count(DISTINCT s.store_key) stores, max(CAST(s.etl_loaded_at AS VARCHAR)) loaded FROM fact_stock_week s WHERE s.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-13' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
